graph.title: LEGO Architecture 21003 Seattle Space Needle

edges.method: axle into hub centre axle hole
axle into hub centre axle hole

notes: Base: two 4x10 plates side by side form a 10x8 footprint; the four 1x8 tiles frame it (print tile at the front). Light gray 4x6 plates fill the inner 8x6; the four 1x6 tiles form a ring on top and the four 2x2 tiles plus stacked round plates fill the middle (positions inferred from the small booklet pictures).

Technic, hose and tower-top pieces are not on a clean stud grid (they hang on axles/pins), so their position is null and their connections are in other_joins. rests_on is used only where studs and anti-studs clutch.
Step 9 column order is inferred: each smooth axle connector is joined to a red axle 2 notched in a chain, with the top red axle going into the step-10 connector.
The three hoses (steps 15) are shown cut to length; each is assumed to go from a lower angled connector to the matching upper one. The exact pairings are inferred.
The tower-top order is inferred from the pictures: dish p38 with plate p30, then gear p25, then plate p31 with dish p39, then the small stack p27/p50/p41/p26.
Step numbers are the booklet's 1-19; the sub-assemblies in steps 5, 7, 14 and 19 use the same step number as their parent.
